titolo: Google rebrands Spark as free Tasks agent with usage limits
descr: Google's Gemini agent, now called Tasks, is free in several regions but limited to a few hours of use per month.
paragrafi: Google has renamed its Spark AI agent to Tasks and made it available at no cost.
The free offering runs on the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model and is limited to a few hours of usage per month.
Meta's Muse agent and OpenAI's Dot and Anthropic's Claude Duet also have free tiers but with similar limits.
perche: Free Tasks gives casual users a way to try AI personal assistance without paying, but the usage caps may push power users toward paid plans or other agents.
